summary.status: all journeys blocked by frontend runtime crash

root_causes.description: The frontend is configured for legacy/mock auth (VITE_AUTH_PROVIDER=legacy, VITE_ENABLE_MOCK_AUTH=true) and main.tsx no longer mounts <ClerkProvider>. However, AuthContext.tsx, ClerkAuthBridge.tsx, and RootRedirect.tsx call Clerk hooks (useAuth, useUser, useOrganization) unconditionally, which throw 'useAuth can only be used within the <ClerkProvider /> component' at runtime.
Journey tests expect business-case workflow state for case id 'case-meridian-e2e-001', but scripts/db/seed-e2e-data.ts only creates 'case-draft-001' and 'case-e2e-approved-001'.
Global setup (global-setup.ts) and package.json scripts use 'pnpm exec tsx' / 'sh -lc' wrappers that fail on Windows (spawn pnpm ENOENT), preventing automated seeding via the documented pnpm command.

sample_error: Error: @clerk/react: useAuth can only be used within the <ClerkProvider /> component. at AuthProvider (http://localhost:3001/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:36:48)
recommendation: Either (a) refactor Clerk hook usage to be conditional on VITE_AUTH_PROVIDER=clerk and add 'case-meridian-e2e-001' to the seeder, then re-run locally; or (b) execute P0 Playwright in a Clerk-configured staging environment with a real IdP/test tenant and the correct seed data.
